title: Simultaneous Kagamimochi 2
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9 \ (1 \leq i \leq N); A_i \leq A_{i+1} \ (1 \leq i < N); 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq L_i < R_i \leq N \ (1 \leq i \leq Q); All input values are integers.
